title: Inject a dependency
summary: A dependency is another function or object that code uses. Passing it in lets a test choose a simple, predictable replacement.
introduction: A dependency is another function or object that code uses. Passing it in lets a test choose a simple, predictable replacement. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A dependency is another function or object that code uses. Passing it in lets a test choose a simple, predictable replacement.

blocks.code:
function greetFrom(getName) { return "Hi " + getName(); }
console.log(greetFrom(() => "Asha") === "Hi Asha");
blocks.title: Inject a dependency

blocks.text: The result is true. The test controls the name without any network request.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Pass a function that returns Ben.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not call a real paid service just to test a greeting.
For more detail later, use this [Unit Testing further reading](https://nodejs.org/api/test.html).
